description: This source file defines a PHP controller class for managing extensions of 'Other' type in the OpenCart admin system. It includes methods for listing, installing, and uninstalling these extensions, with code to handle permissions, loading models, registering controllers and models dynamically, and rendering views or returning JSON responses.

classes.name: Other
classes.description: Controller class for managing 'Other' type extensions in the admin panel, including listing, installing, and uninstalling extensions.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Handles displaying the list of 'Other' extensions by setting the output response with the view generated by getList().

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Generates a list of available and installed 'Other' extensions, loads relevant language entries, and returns an HTML view with the data.

methods.name: install
methods.description: Handles the installation process of an 'Other' extension, including permission checks, registering the extension, and returning a JSON response.

methods.name: uninstall
methods.description: Handles the uninstallation of an 'Other' extension, including permission checks, removing the extension, and returning a JSON response.
